observations: Photo 0 shows two headlamp assemblies (one top/upper, one bottom/lower) with clear lenses and visible mounting brackets/holders.
Photo 0 also shows a separate headlamp mounting/trim piece area around the lamps; no tail light is clearly shown in this photo.
Photo 1 shows a front grille with a central badge/emblem (looks like a stylized “H”/Honda-like shape) and chrome/black slats.
No readable part numbers, vehicle year, or exact model markings are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition available in GRA Ikeja.
claims.evidence: Photos show a front grille (photo 1) and headlamp assemblies (photo 0), but no tail light is clearly visible, and “working condition” cannot be verified from still images.
The grille badge/emblem in photo 1 is not clear enough to confirm “Prado” or the exact vehicle make/model.

risks.risk: Tail light may not be included (photos show headlamps + grille, not a tail lamp).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the tail light(s) laid out (both sides) showing the full lens and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as grille + headlamps only (tail light treated as not included).

risks.risk: “Working condition” is not testable from photos; bulbs/reflectors may be damaged or not functioning.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of the headlamps/tail lamps switched ON (low/high if applicable) with the seller’s hand/phone visible for continuity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (treat as spares/unknown electrical condition).

risks.risk: Fitment risk: grille/headlamp may not match your exact Prado/Jeep variant, year, or side (left/right).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact vehicle year/trim and a photo of any part number label/sticker on the back of the lamps or grille.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case fitment (assume may not fit without modification).

risks.risk: Damage risk: cracks, moisture ingress, or broken tabs may not be obvious in these angles.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of lens edges and all mounting tabs/brackets (front and back) plus a photo against light to check for cracks.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the tail light(s) (full lens + mounting points) to confirm it’s included.
Send a short video showing the lights switched ON (headlamps and tail lamps if present).
Provide the exact vehicle make/model/year/variant the parts fit, and any part number/sticker photo from the back of the lamps/grille.
Close-up photos of lens edges and all mounting tabs/brackets (front and back) to confirm no cracks/broken mounts.
response.reason: The photos confirm a front grille and headlamp assemblies, but the seller claims a tail light and “working condition,” which cannot be verified remotely from these images. Missing tail-light proof and no electrical test proof prevent a safe price decision.
